V93.name: Pre-FOMC uncertainty premium
V93.mechanism: Scheduled monetary-policy uncertainty may command an intraday equity premium before resolution; condition on elevated prior volatility rather than post-release direction.
V93.signal: Scheduled FOMC date in existing official calendar, prior-session SPY 20-day close-return standard deviation above median of 252 prior-session RV20 observations.
V93.trade: Long SPY at 10:00 bar open; exit 13:30 bar open, before 14:00 announcement.
V93.control: Unconditional pre-FOMC SPY with same clocks; report selected high-volatility subset versus excluded low-volatility dates.
V93.novelty: Exact volatility-conditioned rule not located in archive. DT8 proposed unconditional pre-FOMC; V45 tested post-release discovery. Not a claim of literature novelty.

V94.name: Overnight-and-opening pressure reversal
V94.mechanism: Stock-specific selling through the opening half hour may temporarily depress prices and reverse later; this tests stock selection rather than index breadth.
V94.signal: At 10:00 compare each stock 09:00 hourly close (ends10:00) to previous full-session15:00 hourly close (ends16:00), minus SPY 09:30 half-hour close versus previous15:30 half-hour close. Eligible absolute stock return <=15%, positive prices/volumes, at least15 of fixed19 issuers. Select three lowest residuals only if all three are negative.
V94.trade: Equal-weight three stocks, long at11:00 hourly open, exit15:00 hourly open. One-hour buffer after signal.
V94.universe: Existing static20 SIP panel excluding GOOG to avoid double-counting Alphabet; fixed19 survivors, explicit selection bias.
V94.control: Equal-weight all eligible issuers on the same signal days and mirrored top-three residual selection.
V94.novelty: Related to unimplemented overnight-loser proposal and failed event/daily reversals; this exact non-event hourly stock-selection rule not found. It is not a renamed V75 index breadth vote.

V95.name: Alphabet voting-share premium normalization
V95.mechanism: GOOG and GOOGL share issuer economics but can have changing voting/liquidity premiums. An unusually wide same-clock premium may normalize intraday; long cheaper class only, not riskless arbitrage.
V95.signal: At11:00 use GOOG/GOOGL ratio of10:00 hourly closes. Compare log ratio with median and1.4826*MAD of preceding20 same-clock observations, excluding current day. If abs deviation>2scaledMAD and MAD>0, buy relatively cheap class: GOOGL for high ratio, GOOG for low.
V95.trade: Enter12:00 hourly open, exit15:00 hourly open. One-hour buffer.
V95.control: Equal-weight both classes on same signal days; report selected-minus-control return to isolate selection from Alphabet beta.
V95.novelty: No exact dual-class rule located. Related to broad relative-value research, distinct from leverage-wrapper fair-value identities. Not a claim that share classes are freely convertible.

common.later_descriptive: 2024-01-02 through2025-12-31; heavily exposed history, not pristine validation
common.capital: $100 fully funded fractional long portfolio, weights sum1, cash on known no-signal days, zero cash interest; no shorting, leverage, overnight or external trading
common.inputs: Use completed-bar features only; hourly bars start at timestamp. No high/low fill assumptions. All entries and exits use later bar opens.
common.execution: Bar-open reference with adverse cost on both sides; all-in cost assumptions stand in for spread, fees and slippage, not historical observed quotes. Costs double in stress. Fractional fills/capacity/settlement unvalidated.
common.calendar: NYSE regular full16:00 close sessions only for trading; full exchange calendar retained for strategy and SPY equity. Previous-session close features require prior full session. Missing feature/fill days remain explicit unknowns, not silently cash.
common.robustness: Double cost, delayed entry, remove five best trade days, mechanism controls; 5000 five-session circular-block bootstrap draws, seed939495, paired daily excess against SPY and control. 98.333% intervals for three tested primary strategies (Bonferroni family alpha .05).
common.pass_definition: Both development and later period: net compounded return beats matched-calendar SPY total return; doubled-cost and remove-five results positive; multiplicity-adjusted lower excess bound positive; no unresolved days. Positive bar results still require independent quote and point-in-time-universe validation. No old minimum-frequency veto: sparse hypotheses are tested and their limited samples reported.
common.benchmark: Cached Yahoo adjusted OHLC total-return proxy; first calendar day adjusted open to close then adjusted close-to-close. No benchmark friction, conservative hurdle.
